tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the Markdown document of any public page, exactly as HTTP serves it, from a root-relative path (/patterns/supervisor.md) or a https://topologyindex.com URL. Private tenant routes are not reachable here. A pattern, starter or formation read may add a second item containing a one-time use tick

tools.name: list_starters
tools.description: The starter formation index (/starters/index.md): unvalidated, unsigned FORMATION.md documents to copy and register privately. With a task class, only the starters that declare it (/starters/index.md?task_class={task_class}). The response includes exact fetch calls for the starter paths.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Limited rollout: only for a use ticket from a pattern, starter or formation read. If you have no ticket, do not call it. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
